decision_zh: 新增官方文档说明了直连 DeepSeek Chat Completions 的 max_tokens 和 reasoning_tokens 字段，但没有把这些语义、全部可计费类别及单请求价格上限绑定到当前 OpenCode Go 部署。既有 0.50 USD 仍是条件估算，不能作为 STRICT UPPER_BOUND；仅 LIVE 预算门保持关闭，CLI/Desktop 源码和本地 FIXTURE 工作可继续。

prior_resource_fact.authorized_intake_result: GET catalog listed model; one repaired POST returned HTTP 200 with the same response model; returned cost was null, not zero

targeted_new_public_findings.observation: Official search result for the Chat Completions API describes max_tokens as the maximum tokens generated in the completion, allowed 1..393216; prompt plus generated tokens are constrained by model context. It lists usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens as a completion breakdown.
targeted_new_public_findings.inference_limit: This supports direct DeepSeek API terminology. The fetched search excerpt is not a full versioned contract for OpenCode Go, and does not prove Go forwards or enforces 8192 across every charged output category.

targeted_new_public_findings.observation: Official pricing search result says DeepSeek bills the total number of model input and output tokens and identifies DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash behind its Flash route.
targeted_new_public_findings.inference_limit: Direct DeepSeek billing language does not attest to the current OpenCode Go gateway account, mapping, possible internal attempts, cache-write billing, or maximum effective price.

targeted_new_public_findings.observation: Official Go documentation describes monthly dollar allowances and 5-hour/weekly fractions, a route and peak/off-peak prices, and labels request counts as estimates whose actual usage varies.
targeted_new_public_findings.inference_limit: An allowance checked over time is not a provider-enforced maximum charge or resource consumption for this individual request.

pinned_public_gateway_call_path_rechecke.request_body: Pinned packages/console/app/src/routes/zen/util/requestBody.ts replaces the model field and otherwise passes the request stream; it does not establish a max_tokens clamp or dollar reservation.
pinned_public_gateway_call_path_rechecke.migration_proxy: Pinned packages/console/app/src/lib/inference-proxy.ts maps POST /zen/go/v1/chat/completions to /go/openai/v1/chat/completions at Resource.ConsoleMigration.inferenceUrl for migrated requests; destination owns authentication and accounting.
pinned_public_gateway_call_path_rechecke.legacy_accounting: Pinned handler computes cost after provider usage; reasoning tokens are a breakdown of normalized output, and cache-write categories can be charged if configured.
pinned_public_gateway_call_path_rechecke.deployment_binding: NOT_EVIDENCED: public dev source and model catalog do not attest which branch, destination build, upstream provider set, configuration, or rate card the current Go deployment uses.

bounded_arithmetic_counterexample.interpretation: A token allocation within the catalog's 1M context and 384K output metadata exceeds 0.50 at published peak prices. This is a mathematical counterexample to deriving a 0.50 cap from catalog limits alone, not an observed request or actual bill.

remaining_exact_evidence_needed: A versioned OpenCode Go per-request contract or current-deployment configuration attestation binding this exact deepseek-v4.1-flash route to an enforced combined billable input cap and an enforced generated-output cap covering reasoning_content, visible content, tool markup, cache and all other charged categories.

A maximum effective price for each charged category, including peak or tier changes and cache writes, plus a guarantee or accounting bound for internal upstream attempts and routing changes. The deployed service version and configuration must be bound to these facts.

Alternatively, a provider-enforced per-request monetary cap with an authenticated pre-dispatch receipt covering the exact request and all internal attempts; monthly or rolling allowances are insufficient.
Only after such evidence exists, bind the accepted basis to the exact ResearchOS route/profile/maxUSD before the original PREPARED transition. No old UNKNOWN effect is redispatched.
minimal_root_next_step: Keep LIVE budget gate closed. Continue registered CLI/Desktop source and local FIXTURE work. Seek one exact-route deployed contract/configuration attestation or provider-enforced per-request cap receipt; do not spend on a probe to infer the maximum. Review and bind that evidence before any new LIVE dispatch.
